race.description: B2 Sign Co Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: PRIMA VECCHIO (6) resumes as the one to beat, with two trials since last racing and a debut fourth at this track that reads well for a Mdn of this shape. His final run last campaign came in CL1 company at Scone in what has proven a strong form reference. Has more upside than most and can make the perfect return. DEKKA'S LATEST (3) looms as the main danger with placings in his two runs back. The first time blinkers give him a clear chance to sharpen third-up. MERRY STEER (10) is an interesting debut runner as a half-sister to Listed winner Everyday Lady. Showed good improvement in her latest trial and is drawn kindly. Will pay to watch for any market moves. THIRTY DEGREES (9) finds the maiden win elusive but has efforts littered through his form that are competitive. Keeping safe for a minor spot.
